detail.description:
Get ready to discover what “Life is…” really means!

Travel across Lithuania with young people from all over the world – explore vibrant Vilnius, discover the Baltic seaside, swim, kayak, take on outdoor adventures and experience places most tourists never see.

But “Life is…” is much more than travelling. It’s about making friends from different cultures, sharing food and traditions at international evenings, trying something new, laughing a lot and creating memories together.

You’ll experience real Lithuanian life, meet local people, discover our culture and nature, take part in fun team challenges and LIONS service activities – and probably return home with friends in countries you had never visited before.

Life is friendship. Life is adventure. Life is sharing. Life is… something you have to experience yourself.

SAILING, KAYAKING, WINDSURFING, PADDLE DESKS, INTEGRATION WORKSHOPS, EVENINGS BY THE CAMPFIRE, LOCAL ATTRACTIONS, KARAOKE EVENING, MEETING YOUTH FROM DIFFERENT CULTURES AND COUNTRIES, COUNTRY AND FLAG PRESENTATION AND MANY OTHER ACTIVITIES

detail.description:
Throughout the program, participants have the chance to experience Turkey’s cultural heritage and natural beauty in the most vivid way. Organized trips to major cities such as Bursa, Istanbul, Eskişehir, and Bandırma allow participants to explore both the lively atmosphere of city centers and the hidden charms of surrounding provinces. Each destination offers a unique opportunity to discover Turkey’s history, nature, and lifestyle up close.
The trekking tours on Uludağ Mountain provide an invigorating outdoor adventure, combining physical activity with breathtaking mountain views. Summer favorites such as swimming and boat trips offer refreshing moments by the sea, while various sports activities help boost energy and strengthen team spirit.
Visits to Turkey’s rich cultural landmarks through museum tours create an inspiring journey into the past. Cooking workshops give participants the chance to prepare traditional Turkish dishes with their own hands, and art workshops offer a creative space to express imagination and craftsmanship.
The world famous Grand Bazaar tours in Istanbul, along with shopping activities, present a colorful exploration filled with traditional and modern products. Fun filled bowling events, lively parties, concerts, and social gatherings add a dynamic and joyful rhythm to the program.
One of the most memorable moments is the opportunity to meet Leo & Lions members, where participants build meaningful connections and friendships. The Welcome & Information Night marks a warm and engaging start to the program, setting the tone for an unforgettable experience.

Istanbul, the city that connects two continents and allows you to step on two separate continents in a single day, is one of the most beautiful and magical cities in the world. This unique feature makes the city very special both historically and culturally. At this point where the two continents  
meet; we will warmly share the spirit of Istanbul with our guests, the young people, through its cuisine, sea, pools, history, abundant entertainment, sports activities music, and many more surprises. Also, during the first week of your arrival in  Istanbul, you will have the opportunity to experience Turkish culture and family structure in a warm, natural setting with a local family. Enjoy it!
